meta.name: add-mnemon
meta.description: Add persistent graph-based memory via mnemon. Agents recall past context before responding and remember insights after each turn.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让智能体记住每次对话的上下文和洞察
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想让智能体在多次对话中保持记忆
copy.tagline_en: Enable agents to remember context and insights across conversations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your agent to retain memory across turns

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 每次回答前会自动调出相关记忆，对话结束后会把新的要点存进持久化记忆库，重启后仍保留。
howto.when: 每次对话回复前自动检索相关记忆，每轮对话后自动存储新信息。当你在新会话中提旧事时，会主动补上前情。

say.text: 你还记得我们上次聊过的项目进度吗？
say.note: 触发记忆检索，Claude 会补上之前的上下文。

say.text: 请记住我喜欢用深色主题。
say.note: 这会被存入持久记忆，下次自动想起。

say.text: 我们之前对这个问题有什么结论？

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude automatically recalls relevant memories before each reply and saves new insights after each turn, persisting across restarts.
howto.when_en: Triggered on every reply: relevant memory is surfaced before responding, and new insights are stored after each turn. In a new session, referencing old topics brings up prior context automatically.

say_en.text: Do you remember the project progress we discussed last time?
say_en.note: Triggers memory recall; Claude brings up prior context.

say_en.text: Please remember I prefer dark mode.
say_en.note: This gets saved to persistent memory and recalled automatically.

say_en.text: What conclusions did we draw on this before?
